actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 405 - 3 (Roll no. 147). (text: CR H2398)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 405 - 3 (Roll no. 147). (text: CR H2398)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H2403-2404)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 1804.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H2398-2399)
Mr. Williams (TX) moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 22.
Reported by the Committee on Small Business. H. Rept. 119-33.
Reported by the Committee on Small Business. H. Rept. 119-33.
Ordered to be Reported by the Yeas and Nays: 25 - 0.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Small Business.

dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agency personnel responsible for preparing reports and congressional committees receiving them.
dimensions.evidence: The Director shall submit to Congress, in addition to the report required under subsection (h)(2), an annual report

dimensions.assessment: Changes are administrative, requiring compilation of data on loans, agents, and fees rather than altering substantive rights or benefits.
dimensions.evidence: the number of 7(a) agents assisting applicants for loans under section 7(a), disaggregated by the type of 7(a) agents

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue changes are specified in the text.
Amends the Small Business Act to add specific annual reporting mandates for loan agents.
dimensions.evidence: Section 47 of the Small Business Act (15 U.S.C. 657t) is amended by adding at the end the following new subsection

dimensions.assessment: Establishes an ongoing annual reporting requirement with permanent reach across the federal program.
dimensions.evidence: an annual report including, for the calendar year covered by the report

missing_information: Specific cost estimates or budgetary impacts for producing the required reports.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes administrative reporting requirements for the Small Business Administration regarding 7(a) loan agents and fees, affecting federal reporting processes and oversight without altering loan eligibility or funding levels.
